title: Prime Minister congratulates Manisha Keer, Neeru and Aashima Ahlawat on winning Silver in Women’s Trap Team event at Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has congratulated Manisha Keer, Neeru and Aashima Ahlawat on winning the Silver medal in the Women’s Trap Team event at the Asian Games.
The Prime Minister described their performance as a commendable display of precision, focus and teamwork.
Shri Modi wished the entire team continued success and expressed hope that they would bring more laurels to India.
The Prime Minister’s Office said in X post;
“Congratulations to Manisha Keer, Neeru and Aashima Ahlawat on winning the Silver medal in the Women’s Trap Team event at the Asian Games.
It was a commendable display of precision, focus and teamwork. May the entire team continue to excel and bring more laurels to India: PM @narendramodi”
